total_model.summary: Model projects 46.2 total points (SF 25, MIN 21). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.6), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.2), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
